title: Open-MMUnlearning: Unifying Methods and Evaluation for MLLM Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2610.10358v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) become more capable and widely deployed, concerns about privacy and safety have become increasingly pressing. Machine unlearning offers one approach to addressing these concerns by removing designated information from trained models while preserving unrelated capabilities. However, fragmented implementations and evaluation protocols, incomplete robustness testing, and limited understanding of metric reliability make progress in MLLM unlearning difficult to assess systematically. We introduce Open-MMUnlearning, an open-source, extensible framework that integrates target-model preparation, multimodal data processing, unlearning, and evaluation through shared interfaces and structured configurations. translated_title: Open-MMUnlearning：统一多模态大语言模型遗忘的方法与评估
translated_abstract: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能力不断增强并得到广泛部署，隐私和安全方面的担忧日益紧迫。机器遗忘为解决这些问题提供了一种途径，即从训练后的模型中移除指定信息，同时保留无关能力。然而，碎片化的实现方式和评估协议、不完整的鲁棒性测试，以及对指标可靠性理解的不足，使得多模态大语言模型遗忘的进展难以进行系统性评估。我们提出了Open-MMUnlearning，这是一个开源、可扩展的框架，通过共享接口和结构化配置，将目标模型准备、多模态数据处理、遗忘和评估整合在一起。该框架支持五个涵盖隐私、安全和版权领域的基准测试、来自四个模型家族的八个多模态大语言模型，以及十二种遗忘方法。其评估套件联合评估遗忘效果……
tldr: 本文提出了开源可扩展框架Open-MMUnlearning，通过共享接口与结构化配置统一了多模态大语言模型遗忘中的模型准备、数据处理、遗忘方法与评估流程，支持五大基准、八个模型和十二种遗忘方法，为系统评估MLLM遗忘进展提供了统一平台。
en_tdlr: Open-MMUnlearning is an open-source, extensible framework that unifies target-model preparation, multimodal data processing, unlearning, and evaluation for MLLM unlearning through shared interfaces, supporting five benchmarks, eight MLLMs, and twelve unlearning methods to enable systematic assessment of unlearning progress.
